text: Attempt 5: a high-value city. Homes touch shops, factories are buffered by shops and kept at the south edge, parks in every home segment, dense homes by the lakes, power plant on the river strip away from homes.

Day one: $10,000 bond, taxes homes 6% / shops 5% / factories 4%. Block 1: dense homes y21-26, shops y28-33, homes y35-40, shops y42-47, factories y49-54; 32 small parks; coal plant on the river strip; 12 wired pumps; fire station.
